verdict.rationale: The evidence shows agent tooling: a managed MCP server and an Agent Toolkit that 'adds SumUp API tools'. But the documented scope is limited to managing the account, creating checkouts, processing payments, and refunds. Nothing in the pack documents listing transaction history, retrieving payouts or settlements, or reconciling daily takings into a ledger, so this applicable axis is unsupported.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull transactions and payouts via API and reconcile daily takings into my ledger
